players.bio: Agustín Anello Giaquinta (born April 22, 2002) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union. As a youngster Anello played for the academies of Cornellà and Espanyol before joining Belgian side Lommel in 2019. In September 2021, he signed his first professional contract with the club.
Alejandro Bedoya (born April 29, 1987) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder and captains the Philadelphia Union of Major League Soccer.
Andre Jason Blake (born 21 November 1990) is a Jamaican professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Philadelphia Union of Major League Soccer and the Jamaica national team.
Andrew Vincent Rick (born January 30, 2006) is an American professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union.

Benjamin Bender (born March 7, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Philadelphia Union. He was the first overall selection in the 2022 MLS SuperDraft. Benjamin Bender (born March 7, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Charlotte FC of Major League Soccer.

Bradley Neil Carnell (born 21 January 1977) is a South African football coach and former footballer who played as a defender. He is currently the head coach of Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union.
Bruno Damiani Píriz (born 18 April 2002) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union.

Cavan Sullivan (born September 28, 2009) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for the Philadelphia Union of Major League Soccer. Sullivan made his Major League Soccer debut for the Philadelphia Union on July 17, 2024.

Christopher James "CJ" Olney Jr. is a 19-year-old American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Brooklyn FC in the USL Championship, on loan from Major League Soccer parent club Philadelphia Union. Born on 16 December 2006 in Chicago, Illinois, he is widely recognized as a highly creative attacking midfielder and left-winger.

Danley Jean Jacques (born 20 May 2000) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union and the Haiti national team. Club career Jean Jacques is a youth product of the Haitian club Don Bosco, and began his senior career with them in 2015 making 52 appearances with them, scoring 7 goals. He moved to the reserves of Metz in August 2021.
Ezekiel Alladoh (born 13 September 2005) is a Ghanaian footballer who plays as a forward for Philadelphia Union in Major League Soccer.

Finn Sundstrom is a 19-year-old American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for the Philadelphia Union in Major League Soccer (MLS). Born on 19 November 2006, the 6-foot center-back joined Philadelphia following a standout breakout year in the USL Championship.
Francis "Frankie" Westfield (born December 9, 2005) is an American professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union.

Geiner Martínez is a 23-year-old Colombian professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union. Known for his physical presence, height (1.89 m / 6'3"), and intensive style of play, he primarily occupies a central defensive role on the right side.

George Henry Marks (born November 10, 1999) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union. Career Youth Marks joined the North Carolina FC academy in 2015, where he played until 2018.

Indiana Denchev Vassilev (born February 16, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union and the United States national team. He has represented the United States at the under-17, under-18, and under-20 levels.

Japhet Sery Larsen (born 10 April 2000) is a Danish professional footballer who plays for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union as a centre-back. Sery is a product of the FC Midtjylland academy and began his senior career with the club in 2020. He transferred to Norwegian club SK Brann in 2021 and to FK Bodø/Glimt in 2022, before returning to SK Brann in 2023.
Jeremy Michael Rafanello (born April 14, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a forward and winger for the Philadelphia Union of Major League Soccer.

Jesús Daniel Bueno Áñez (born 15 April 1999) is a Venezuelan professional footballer who plays for the Philadelphia Union of Major League Soccer. He primarily plays as a defensive midfielder. Club career Deportivo Lara Bueno played for Deportivo Lara as a youth before making his professional debut on October 23, 2016, as a starter in a 2–1 loss to Zamora.

Jovan Lukić (Serbian Cyrillic: Јован Лукић; born 20 January 2002) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Philadelphia Union in Major League Soccer. Career On 12 January 2023, Lukić signed for LASK on a long-term contract, joining S.C.U. Torreense on loan until the end of the season.

Kai Harley Wagner is a German professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union. Club career SSV Ulm 1846 Ahead of the 2015–16 season, Wagner signed his first professional contract at 18 years old with SSV Ulm 1846 competing in the Oberliga Baden-Württemberg, the fifth tier of German football.
Milan Iloski (born July 29, 1999) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a forward for the Philadelphia Union of Major League Soccer.

Nathan Harriel (born April 23, 2001) is an American soccer player who plays as a defender for the Philadelphia Union in Major League Soccer. Career Harriel appeared as an amateur player for USL Championship side Bethlehem Steel during their 2019 season, as well as being part of the Philadelphia Union academy. In 2019, Harriel verbally committed to play college soccer at Clemson University.

Olivier Mbaissidara Mbaizo is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as a defender for the Philadelphia Union in Major League Soccer and the Cameroon national team. Olivier Mbaissidara Mbaizo is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as a defender for the Philadelphia Union in Major League Soccer and the Cameroon national team.
Philippe Ndinga Ossiabadjouo is a 20-year-old Congolese professional football player who serves as a left-back and defender for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union.

Quinn Krippendorff Sullivan (born March 27, 2004) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for the Philadelphia Union of Major League Soccer. Club career Sullivan, who is a dual citizen (Germany), began his youth career at Fishtown A.C. And then transferred to the Philadelphia Union Academy where he attended the prestigious YSC Academy School.
